wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Zerah
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Live article, “An Edomite” section, lines 124–129: Zerah is identified as an Edomite chief, second son of Reuel and grandson of Esau; the article cites Genesis 36:13,17. Fixed 1CH 1:44 gives the same Reuel–Esau genealogy.
